title: POLRMT over-expression is linked to WNT/beta-catenin signaling, immune infiltration, and unfavorable outcomes in lung adenocarcinoma patients.

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Current empirical LUAD analysis explicitly tests POLRMT expression against a literal lifespan outcome and reports completed multi-omics analysis.

evidence_spans.quote: Multi-omics data (genomics, transcriptomics, and proteomics) from publicly available databases were used to assess the role of POLRMT expression and function in LUAD.

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report presents completed analysis of biological data. It does not explicitly apply MR/IV/SMR, an assigned or engineered manipulation with analyzed outcomes, or a qualifying directed model.

evidence_spans.quote: POLRMT expression was positively correlated with immunosuppressive genes, thereby affecting immune infiltration.
